annotation_status: Agent-generated direct-reading annotations with calibration and agent review; not human-coded, blinded, independent human gold labels.
encoding: UTF-8 JSON; deterministic gzip header mtime0 and empty filename; canonical JSON key order.
original_raw_log_character_counts: own_raw_log_chars and peer_raw_log_chars report original lengths; path redaction can change lengths in sanitized full source logs.
scientific_scope: Descriptive observational corpus, not causal identification of behavioral mechanisms.
selection_scope: Frozen736-record snapshot only; later tests and missing/empty runs are not manufactured or silently added.
